problem.title: Populate Next Right Pointers in Each Node
problem.problemStatement: Given a binary tree, connect every node to its immediate neighbor on the same level using a next pointer. If no such neighbor exists, the next pointer must be set to null.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the binary tree.
problem.output: • Print the value of the next pointer for every node in level order.
